title: Security Deposit Account Service Terms: Final Statement, Refunds and Disputes
content:
These are the resident-facing service terms of the Security Deposit Account for the end of a tenancy and for a move within the community, set out by deposit program. All six programs carry the same terms.

| Term | Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | Reduced Deposit Plan | Standard Deposit Plan | Premier Residence Deposit Plan | Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | Enhanced Deposit Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur service standard for issuing the final account statement (calendar days after move-out) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Statement delivery | email and mail | email and mail | email and mail | email and mail | email and mail | email and mail |
| Refund method when the resident has not chosen one | paper check | paper check | paper check | paper check | paper check | paper check |
| Payee of a refund when several leaseholders signed | all leaseholders, one refund | all leaseholders, one refund | all leaseholders, one refund | all leaseholders, one refund | all leaseholders, one refund | all leaseholders, one refund |
| Uncashed refund check voided and handled as unclaimed property after (calendar days from issue) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Forwarding address requested at notice and at move-out | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Window to dispute an itemized line (calendar days after the statement) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Time to decide a deposit dispute (calendar days) | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Deposit carries over unchanged on an in-community transfer | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

### In plain terms

- The final account statement is issued, as Larkspur's service standard, within 20 calendar days of move-out. It is sent both by email and by mail.
- A refund goes by paper check unless the resident has chosen another method. When several leaseholders signed, one refund is paid to all of them together.
- A refund check not cashed within 180 calendar days of issue is voided and handled as unclaimed property.
- An itemized line may be disputed within 30 calendar days after the statement, and a dispute is decided within 15 calendar days.
- On a transfer to another apartment home in the same community, the deposit carries over unchanged.
